terra.problem: The Teacher does not say the sight was unexpected or explain that it was why he called his life futile.
Papa addresses the baker as both ma’am and sir rather than as baker or friend.
The casserole joke mentions a food outside the permitted cookie-making foods.
The joke about making this a short verse makes the way Scripture is written the joke.
The Teacher says he tested ‘all this’ by wisdom, not that he tested everything.
The explanation simply repeats the verse and notes that the Teacher asks a question. It feels flat and adds no insight.
‘Pleasing God is the one who gets away’ confuses the action with the man who escapes.
Papa says he searched a drawer for years, changing his backstory: he was stuck in the drawer, not searching it for years.
Saying nothing has turned up overlooks the Teacher’s statement in the same verse that he found one upright man among a thousand.
The explanation mechanically repeats the answer and ends with ‘So that’s the answer,’ without adding Papa’s voice or insight.
